title: Confine the upload path
prompt:
Implement `resolve_upload(base, name)` returning the joined, normalized path for a user-supplied file name — or raising `ValueError('traversal')` when the name:

- is empty, absolute (`/etc/passwd`), or contains a NUL character
- contains any `..` component (`../../etc/passwd`)
- would resolve outside `base` after joining

Valid names (`'report.pdf'`, `'sub/dir/img.png'`) resolve to `base/name` strings.

tests.name: legitimate names resolve inside base
tests.hint: Subdirectories are fine — escaping the root is not.

tests.name: every traversal shape is rejected
tests.hint: Empty, absolute, `..`, sneaky prefix, and NUL all fail closed.
